summary: GreenPower Motor Company Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the completion of the fourth tranche of a Series A Convertible Preferred Share private placement, issuing 1,500 shares for gross proceeds of US$1,425,000 under a November 2025 securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor. Each preferred share converts into common shares at a rate based on 105% of stated value divided by 125% of the prior day's closing price. A 5% cash placement fee is payable to Digital Offering LLC. This is a routine equity financing tranche, not a special-situation event; no acquirer, target, or board recommendation is involved. Watch for future tranche issuances under the facility.
